summary.en: The caret falls flat into the line under what it typed, in two moves that never cross the text: height first at its own place, then width both ways under the phrase.
summary.zh: 光标平躺成它所敲文字下的那条线，分两步、从不越过文字：先在原地把高度降到线高，再向两边拉宽到字下。

fits: Any typed phrase whose caret should become its underline; played back, a line contracting into a caret.
notFor: Text that keeps being typed; a caret that should vanish.

intent.en: Keep one object on screen as it changes job, without crossing the words being read.
intent.zh: 让同一个物体换工作时一直在画面上，而且不越过正在读的字。

fits.zh: 任何要把光标变成下划线的敲字；倒放就是线缩回光标。

notFor.zh: 还在继续敲的字；要消失的光标。

en: Moving width and height together drags the caret across the last letters: keep the two moves.
zh: 宽高同时变会把光标拖过最后几个字：保持两步。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
